name: Chord with a full-force-vector position gate
tagline: The branch direction and magnitude can both change the learned position step.
description: Each sublayer uses the inner product of a width-D parameter and the raw attention or MLP output in a softplus step gate. The position update uses unit-RMS force and both lookahead and retention are static.
mechanism: Normalized force direction and projected velocity
limitations: Research run with matched random output projections and a high Chord learning rate.
